name: WaivOps NRG-CP

evidence.statement: Zenodo publishes version 1.0 of the NRG-CP record and identifies the acquisition archive by name and MD5.
Publisher states that the dataset was compiled by WaivOps, managed by Patchbanks, and that recordings were sourced from verified composers and providers for copyright clearance.
CC BY 4.0 permits sharing and adaptation for commercial purposes subject to attribution and the other license terms.

Locally downloaded archive matches the published MD5; SHA-256 was computed as ceb0f0b8d808150364a1ded15a1f54f9dc3a66f6f51dc0708c8242b62ae2f382. Archive contains 30,943 .mid files; all pass basic Standard MIDI File header validation.

blockers: Establish that the licensor had authority to grant commercial training and redistribution rights for all contained MIDI material, not merely that the dataset page displays CC BY 4.0.

Compare the computed 30,943-file inventory against an authoritative dataset manifest if one is provided; the archive itself contains 30,943 unique .mid filenames, all with MIDI format 1, 2 tracks, and division 96.
